Method of Attack: Fake proof-of-concept (PoC) exploit for WinRAR CVE-2023-40477 vulnerability that instead creates a batch script to download and execute an encoded PowerShell script which installs VenomRAT malware; VenomRAT executes a key logger, communicates with C2 server to receive commands, and can deploy other payloads and steal credentials
Attack Vector: Malicious fake PoC exploit uploaded to GitHub
